patterns.middleware_pattern: Fastify plugins are registered using app.register(), hooks are added using app.addHook()
patterns.controller_pattern: Controllers use decorators (@Controller, @Get, @Post) and are registered in main.ts
patterns.test_pattern: Security tests live in tests/security/, use vitest, and check server availability before running
patterns.error_handling: All errors use RFC 7807 Problem Details format via serializeError()

existing_implementations.description: Found existing middleware registration pattern in fastify.adapter.ts using app.register() for CORS and app.addHook() for request/response logging
